generate_compilation_database: run bazel build with compilation database aspect to generate compile_commands.json for all targets
filter_compile_targets: filter compilation database entries to exclude headers, generated files, or external dependencies
modify_compile_command: modify compiler commands to remove C++11 flags, fix VSCode iquote issues, or strip system headers
fix_compilation_database: process and write a filtered compilation database to compile_commands.json with modified commands
check_header_file: check if a filename is a C++ header file by testing for .h, .hh, .hpp, or .hxx extensions
